card.line: Pergamum was a city in Asia Minor where one of the seven churches stood, and Jesus spoke to it, praising its faithfulness and warning it to repent.

moments.title: Sent to seven churches
moments.text: Jesus tells John to write what he sees and send it to seven churches. Pergamum is one of the cities named.

moments.title: Jesus speaks to Pergamum
moments.text: Jesus, who holds the sharp double-edged sword, praises the church for holding fast to His name, even when Antipas was killed. He warns those who follow false teaching to repent, and promises hidden manna and a white stone to the one who overcomes.
